result_text:
Confirmed — that's the complete set of call sites. All calls pass only 2 arguments, so every one would fail once `options` becomes required.

**Files to edit** (besides `localApiTransport.ts`), each call site needs a third `{ timeoutMs }` argument added:

- `packages/web-core/src/shared/lib/api.ts` (5 call sites: lines 127, 1013, 1038, 1067, and one more upload variant)
- `packages/web-core/src/shared/hooks/useWorkspaces.ts` (1 call site, line 97)
- `packages/remote-web/src/shared/hooks/useRelayWorkspaceHostHealth.ts` (1 call site, line 28)

**Packages that would fail type-check until fixed:**
- `@vibe/web-core` — directly contains the failing calls in `api.ts` and `useWorkspaces.ts`
- `@vibe/local-web` — transitively type-checks `web-core`'s `api.ts`/`useWorkspaces.ts` via the `@/*` → `../web-core/src/*` path alias (imported through `Bootstrap.tsx`/`ConfigProvider.tsx`)
- `@vibe/remote-web` — same transitive path-alias inclusion of `web-core`'s files, plus its own direct call in `useRelayWorkspaceHostHealth.ts`

`@vibe/ui` does not import any of these modules, so it is unaffected.

```json
{"files": ["packages/web-core/src/shared/lib/api.ts", "packages/web-core/src/shared/hooks/useWorkspaces.ts", "packages/remote-web/src/shared/hooks/useRelayWorkspaceHostHealth.ts"], "packages": ["@vibe/web-core", "@vibe/local-web", "@vibe/remote-web"]}
```
